shared_elements: low relief carving on a broad pillar/stone slab
register of repeated animals in profile along the upper edge
horizontal band of vertical/zigzag hatching acting as a divider
quadruped animals in profile in a row
bird-like creature with long neck and beak
schematic figures carved in shallow relief on a vertical face
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive scheme: a top register of repeated animals in profile marching in a row, separated by a horizontal band of vertical hatching/zigzag from a lower field with larger profile quadrupeds, serpentine forms and a long-necked bird-headed creature at the bottom, all in the same shallow, schematic outline relief. The only differences are of viewing angle and preservation, plus minor variation in the number and species of the lower animals; the iconographic programme appears essentially identical.
